summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added the "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst, and wrote tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run: I only measured line lengths (none over 120 columns in the three Python files). Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-object top-level JSON value is reported as a missing key, and a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError. List-valued paths are implemented but not covered by a unit test, since the spec asks for scalar paths in the tests.
